When so used, any field referencing a 'State or Territory' may be used to indicate New Zealand.
I am seeking registration for the following occupation in New South Wales in accordance with the mutual recognition principle — Driving Instruction.
3. Details of Current Interstate Registration for this Occupation

Note: registration includes any licence, admission, approval, certificate, etc. Specify all the States in which you currently hold or previously held registration for this occupation. A copy of the current registration document(s) or licence must accompany this notice.
Are there any conditions, limitations or restrictions which apply to your registration in any State or Territory? If so, provide details below.
5. Registration Status in Other States or Territories

In relation to the occupation for which registration is sought, I declare that (* cross out whichever is not applicable; provide details if necessary):

(a) I am / am not the subject of disciplinary proceedings in any State or Territory (including preliminary investigations that may lead to disciplinary proceedings) in relation to this occupation; and

(b) My registration in any State or Territory is / is not cancelled or currently suspended as a result of disciplinary action; and

(c) I give consent to Transport for NSW to make enquiries of, and the exchange of information with, the authorities of any State or Territory regarding my activities in the relevant occupation and any other matters relevant to this notice.

ap10001-add-remove-category.pdf.text: Privacy Collection Notice: NSW Fair Trading, Department of Customer Service gives priority to protecting the privacy of your personal information. We do this by handling personal information in a responsible manner and in accordance with the Privacy and Personal Information Protection Act 1998 (PPIP Act) and the Health Records and Information Privacy Act 2002 (HRIP Act). Service NSW will collect and use the personal information you provide through your MyServiceNSW Account to verify your identity and confirm your current contact details. The personal information contained in your application is collected and held by NSW Fair Trading. Information collected includes: full name, date of birth, contact details (address, email and phone number), proof of identity information, and other personal information required to check eligibility requirements.
